tone.says: Sec. 3.2.5-3.2.6: Min Zhuang shows the Nong-type register split of PT tones A, B, C by original initial voicing; PT D1S and D1L merge (loss of contrastive vowel length); synchronically Balong Min Zhuang has six tone values 35, 33, 11, 31, 22, 55 with checked-syllable tones identical to unchecked categories (D1S = C2, D2S = A2, D1L = B1, D2L = B2); table 'Min Zhuang Zhuang Tone System': tone 1 A1 35(24), 2 A2 33(55), 3 C1 22(33/32), 4 C2=D2S 55(54/53), 5 B1=D1L=D1S 11(22), 6 B2=D2L 31; Li Type I…
